consentScope: Anonymized internal migration evidence and changes to the consumer repository; public case-study publication is not authorized.

migration.includes: implementation, analyzer repair, dependency installation, one failed build diagnosis, correction, and successful rebuild

negativeFindings: The migration analyzer initially missed v1 re-exports; support and tests for named, aliased, type-only, namespace, and star re-exports were added before accepting the result.
The v1 zipPar bridge erased tuple inference in the vanilla template and required an explicit tuple assertion at the facade boundary.

zipPar is absent from the documented v2 preview. Stable 1.22.0 keeps it on the root; the beta rehearsal moves only that fallback to supported /core. One consumer is insufficient evidence for a new v2 API.
The first beta install exposed two distribution defects before this record passed: prerelease peer ranges rejected the beta, and Agent/Perf linked to the shrinking package root instead of /core.
rollbackPath: Inside the beta, replace each local facade with /v1 exports plus a one-line Effect.fromPromiseAbortable adapter; for full reversal restore the stable-v1 lockfile and stable-root facade. Both variants build and no persisted data or runtime-state migration is involved.
limitations: This is one template consumer with two framework variants, not an independent external production workload.
The validation proves type-checking and production bundling but does not execute the demo's external HTTP requests.
Latency, CPU, memory, retention, upgrade lag, and operational reliability are not represented by this migration.
Consent covers anonymized internal evidence only, so this record is not a publishable case study.
The beta candidate was packed and installed locally; this record does not claim registry publication or external production use.
reproduce: node scripts/analyze-v2-migration.mjs --json <authorized-consumer-source>/templates; npm run test:templates -- --runtime-tarball <brass-runtime-1.22.0.tgz>; npm run test:templates:rollback -- --runtime-tarball <brass-runtime-1.22.0.tgz>; npm run test:templates -- --runtime-tarball <brass-runtime-2.0.0-beta.0.tgz>; npm run test:templates:v1-bridge -- --runtime-tarball <brass-runtime-2.0.0-beta.0.tgz>
